title: Deep Phase 2 stations: island or side
detail: 19 deep stations on the 9.0 m bore (Lines 8, 10, 11, 12) and Pennsylvania Station on Line 1 have side platforms. An island on the bore needs the tracks to spread from 3.9 to 10.9 m, which a deep station cannot do in a cut-and-cover box: a mined station and approaches, or keep side platforms.
